scope: One introductory sentence; existing functionality and noindex unchanged.
mainText:
Site search Search the field guide Search for a boss, item, island, achievement, or the problem blocking your run. You can also browse the categories below.

Search needs JavaScript, but every published section remains available below.

Browse by category Start with the section closest to the problem blocking your run: Guides — Start How to Fish with a beginner route, difficulty choices, early spending advice, and focused progression guides for your next objective. Walkthrough — Follow the main quest chain from the lighthouse to the end route. Islands — Unlock each destination and understand the item or boss gate in the way. Bosses — Find the How to Fish boss order, required quest bait, fight strategies, healing preparation, and trophy hand-ins for your next island. Items — Find what to keep, buy, upgrade, or use next: weapons, lures, boss bait, radar, grilling, money, and other How to Fish items. Achievements — Separate story unlocks from cleanup, challenge runs, and collection goals. Fixes — Find the right How to Fish fix for crashes, black screens, Steam relay errors, private lobbies, save problems, missing leeches, and camera controls.
